selection: All 48 frozen windows, no outcome selection; >=14 usable baseline sleep+clock days and >=7 current sleep+clock days
sleep_quality: Finite nonnegative sleep_minutes <=1440 and sleep_info_code==0; nonzero/unknown code excluded from physiological sleep features; repeated identical records allowed; clocks circular and timezone unknown

donors.primary: latest eligible nonoverlapping 7-day block within target baseline days 1..28
donors.sensitivity: earliest eligible nonoverlapping 7-day block within target baseline days 1..28
donors.background: tile chosen complete raw week six times; preserve target day/weekday/phase, replace ALL metrics/quality/missingness jointly

features.clock: current circular start-clock SD hours capped at 6
features.activity: (60-current mean Fitbit active-class minutes)/60; device category only

scorer_policy.missing_feature: absent summary yields neutral policy feature 0, never replace raw null with measurement zero; missing coverage separately retained
scorer_policy.interpretation: Research policy, no medical optimality or independent real model claim

derived_negative_control: Independently replace derived feature coordinates; separate estimand; no source-game error comparison
budget_note: nsamples excludes baseline/foreground; count actual scorer calls, unique coalitions and initialization separately; max unique=2^n
flow_scope: all primary eligible windows, two policy scorers, P1 six groups; internal edge game evaluated separately
sensitivity_scope: all eligible windows, both donor strategies; 8 groups for P1 primary donor; A1 panel primary donor 6 groups
holdout_interventions: For each block, remove it from full foreground; compare signed observed change with attribution and random equal-size source; descriptive association, not an attribution axiom
